script_text: Stop, Pisces: the cosmos demands a financial reality check. Mars is conjunct Jupiter in Cancer, activating your 5th House of romance, creativity, and risk; Jupiter rules your 10th House. Saturn is conjunct your ruling planet Neptune in Aries, pressing your 2nd House of income and value. As a water sign, you sense the shift, but this conjunction demands receipts, budgets, and boundaries. In love, a flirtation or invitation arrives; singles could meet someone through children, art, or a trip, while couples should plan pleasure before debating the past. Professionally, Mercury in Virgo sharpens your 7th House of clients and contracts; one conversation can trigger a promotion or assignment this week after you name your rate. Avoid signing a vague deal or lending cash; an unexpected refund arrives through a property contact by Friday afternoon this week. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
